templates.name: Tutorial 3D
templates.description: Learn the basics in 5 minutes: move around, play, and make a coin.

steps.title: Look around
steps.text: Hold the right mouse button and move the mouse to look around. Use WASD while holding it to fly, and the mouse wheel to zoom.

steps.title: Select the Player
steps.text: Click the orange capsule in the view, or "Player" in the Hierarchy on the left. The Inspector on the right shows what it's made of.

steps.title: Play the game
steps.text: Press the Play button at the top (the triangle). Walk with WASD, jump with Space.

steps.title: Collect the coin
steps.text: Walk into the spinning gold coin. Your score goes up.

steps.title: Stop the game
steps.text: Press Stop (the square at the top), or Esc. Everything goes back to how it was.

steps.title: Add a box
steps.text: Click Create (top left), then 3D Shapes, then Cube.

steps.title: Move it
steps.text: With the Move tool, drag the arrows on the cube to put it somewhere new. Or drag the cube itself.

steps.title: Make it a coin
steps.text: In the Inspector, click Add Component, choose Traits, and tick Collectible.

steps.title: Play your game
steps.text: Press Play and collect your new coin.

templates.name: Tutorial 2D
templates.description: Learn 2D in 5 minutes: run, jump, collect, and build a level.

steps.title: Look around
steps.text: Drag in the view to move around the level, and use the mouse wheel to zoom.

steps.title: Select the Player
steps.text: Click the orange rectangle, or "Player" in the Hierarchy. The Inspector shows its parts: a Sprite (how it looks), a Character Controller (how it moves) and Traits.

steps.title: Play the game
steps.text: Press Play (the triangle at the top). A and D (or the arrows) run, Space jumps.

steps.title: Collect the coin
steps.text: Jump onto the ledge and grab the gold coin.

steps.title: Stop the game
steps.text: Press Stop (the square at the top), or Esc.

steps.title: Add a platform
steps.text: Click Create (top left), then 2D, then Platform. It appears in the middle of the view.

steps.title: Move it
steps.text: Drag the platform (or its arrows) somewhere you can jump to.

steps.title: Add a coin
steps.text: Create > 2D > Circle, then in the Inspector: Add Component > Traits, tick Collectible.

templates.name: Forest
templates.description: A player on a path through the trees. Walk with WASD, run with Shift.

templates.name: 2D Parkour
templates.description: Jump across stone platforms: a moving platform, a jump pad, coins, a checkpoint and a star at the end.
